title: Alkekengi
text: This remedy is indicated in cases of urinary disorders, especially those related to the bladder and kidneys. It is useful in cases of dropsy and chronic inflammation of the urinary tract. There is a general feeling of soreness and tenderness in the renal region. Appetite poor. Nausea. Burning in the stomach. Distended and tender. Rumbling. Frequent desire to urinate. Scanty, dark urine. Burning in the urethra. Stones in the bladder. Compare: Berberis; Cantharis; Lycopodium. Tincture to third potency.
